Added synthesis on community open Skill compiled into standalone product vs harness install packs.

selection_reasons.topics/agent-skill-authoring.md: Article centers on an open NVC Agent Skill (180+ GitHub stars) whose rules were compiled into a shipped web tool with Opus 5.5 in ~two hours—fits distill-from-skill / communication-rules authoring.
selection_reasons.topics/workflows-before-agents.md: Runtime product is a fixed rewrite pipeline (flag harsh words, three tiers, send-ready text), not an open-ended agent; Opus appears only in construction.
selection_reasons.topics/agent-skills-open-standard.md: Public GitHub Skill as forkable community rules asset with a second landing path (standalone localhost app), complementing cross-host SKILL.md installs.
selection_reasons.topics/minimal-core-community-extensions: UUMit + localhost sharing without cloud is adjacent to slim/local-first extension patterns, but existing synthesis already covers plugin hosts and Pi edges—no new integrated claim without duplicating workflows-before-agents.
